turns.content: This is about setting goals and keeping track of how the work is going. What are you personally aiming to achieve for the Q4 sales target?
My personal goal is to support Kevin, Mercy, and Joseph in hitting their individual targets of 40 units each, so we can achieve our team goal of 120 units by October 30th.
To make sure your own contribution is clear, what specific numbers and dates are attached to your personal goals for supporting Kevin, Mercy, and Joseph?
My specific numbers and dates are tied to their performance. I need to ensure Kevin closes 40 units, Mercy 40 units, and Joseph 40 units, all by October 30th. I'll be checking proof every Friday.
What are you personally responsible for in your role as a sales manager?
I'm responsible for guiding the team to hit our sales target, making sure deals are tracked properly, and resolving any issues that come up.
What is your plan to ensure each team member knows their specific 40-unit target by October 30th?
They all know their targets already. We set them at the start of the quarter.
You mentioned you'll be checking proof every Friday. What specific proof will you be looking for to confirm Kevin, Mercy, and Joseph have hit their targets?
I'll be looking for proof of payment or a signed order for each sale they've made. No exceptions.
The target is 120 units sold by October 30th. Where does that stand today?
As of today, October 12th, no units have been sold yet. We're still working on current deals.
That leaves a lot of ground to cover in a short time. What is the single biggest blocker right now that is stopping units from closing?
Right now, it's getting those signed orders or payments. That's the key to closing any deal.
That is true of any sales role, and it was true at the start of the month. What is it that makes it a blocker for your team right now, on October 12th, that was not present on October 1st?
It's not a new blocker, it's just that we're deeper into the month and still waiting on these key deals to convert. The pressure is building.
What are you doing this week to convert those specific key deals that you were not doing last week?

I'm going to be following up more closely with each rep on the details of their active deals, especially Kilele Hotel, Greenfield Supermarket, and Mama Pima Stores. I'll also check in on the new leads they're developing.
That gives them more of your time. What else will you do specifically this week to get those deals moving, beyond spending more time?

I'm also going to remind Mercy about confirming sales only with signed orders, and I'll talk to Joseph about keeping his deals active and not letting them go quiet. And I need to decide on Joseph's pricing question.
You are reminding Mercy and talking to Joseph. Those are things you will do. You also said you need to decide on Joseph's pricing question. What will you do specifically about that, and by when?
I'll decide on Joseph's pricing question today. I need to figure out if selling at KES 4,500 for his Mama Pima Stores deal is something we can do.
You will decide that today. What specific activities will you undertake to support these goals for the team, beyond that pricing decision?
I'll be checking in with the team every day to see if there are any obstacles I can help remove. I also need to ensure they're all opening 10 new leads a week.
This check-in is aiming at 120. You said 10. Is that your own part of it?

This check-in is to map out what you are aiming to achieve this period for water dispenser sales to hotels, supermarkets, and shops in Nairobi. What are you planning to achieve with customers for water dispenser sales in Nairobi this period?
I'm working towards hitting our target of 120 units sold by October 30th. Focusing on getting those dispensers into hotels, supermarkets, and shops around Nairobi.
Grace has set a target of 40 units for you by that date; how do you plan to reach that number?
Well, today Kilele Hotel bought 40 units, so I've already hit my target!
That is quick work. For the record, what would show the Kilele Hotel deal was done - a signed order, a payment record, a photo of it, or an email?
Thanks for attaching the mpesa-kilele-hotel.txt document. What does this document confirm about what you have described?
It confirms the M-Pesa payment of KES 200,000 from Kilele Hotel for 40 units, with the code QJK4TL2MX9.
It sounds like you've had a strong start to the period. Beyond hitting this specific target, what are you responsible for in your job, and what does doing well look like in that context?
I'm responsible for generating leads, making sales, and building relationships with businesses in Nairobi. Doing well means consistently hitting my sales targets and bringing in new clients.
Kilele Hotel bought 40 units, and the payment is confirmed. You've closed the deal with Kilele Hotel. What about Greenfield Supermarket and Mama Pima Stores?
I don't have any information about Greenfield Supermarket or Mama Pima Stores.

Understood. You mentioned earlier that your responsibility includes generating leads and bringing in new clients. Aside from Kilele Hotel, what other businesses are you currently working with, and what stage are those sales at?

Today I got a new lead from Savannah Cafe in Kilimani; I called the owner, Jane Mwende, and she wants a price list. I'll send it to her tomorrow morning. I also met Paul, the office manager at Upper Hill Offices, but I don't know yet what they need.
What's the next step with Paul at Upper Hill Offices to find out what they need?
I'll need to follow up with him to understand their requirements. I don't have a specific next step planned just yet.
Which specific customers are you working with to hit those 40 units?
My target of 40 units has been met by Kilele Hotel today. So I'm not specifically working with other customers for that target.

You closed a 40-unit deal on your first day of checking in, and that is a real thing.

I have one more question before we finish. Which part of the plan is yours to do?
My part of the plan is sending the price list to Savannah Cafe tomorrow morning, and tomorrow I'm also visiting two shops on Ngong Road.

You will send the price list to Savannah Cafe tomorrow morning, and you are visiting two shops on Ngong Road tomorrow.

That’s all for today. Below is what I wrote down from your answers. Is anything wrong?
We are setting shared goals for the Sales team, Q4. What are you trying to achieve this period for hotels, supermarkets, and shops in Nairobi?
I'm focused on hitting our target of 120 units sold by October 30th across all those sectors.
You are focused on hitting 120 units by October 30th. For your part, Grace set a target of 40 units for you by October 30th. What is your plan to get there?
I'm going to be pushing hard on new leads and closing existing deals. I'll follow up on everything diligently.
To make sure your own record is clear, what are you responsible for in your job, and what does doing well look like in it?
I'm responsible for generating leads, presenting our products, and closing sales. Doing well means consistently meeting and exceeding my sales targets.
It sounds like you have a clear understanding of your role. Who helped set up your access to these hotels, supermarkets, and shops?
I set up my own access to these places, I did the legwork myself.
That you set up your own access to these locations shows initiative. Which of those conversations was with someone who can actually decide, with the budget and the authority?
For Greenfield Supermarket, I spoke directly with Mrs. Njeri, and she's the buyer there, so she has the authority.
Beyond Greenfield Supermarket, you also have Kilele Hotel and Mama Pima Stores. Which of those are you working on, and if you are not, is there a reason why?
I haven't started on Kilele Hotel or Mama Pima Stores yet. My priority right now is closing the Greenfield deal and following up on the Tuskys Westgate lead.
For the Greenfield deal, who is waiting on whom right now?
Greenfield Supermarket is waiting on me to get the signed order.
You are waiting for the signed order from Greenfield Supermarket, and you are following up on the Tuskys Westgate lead. What is the next thing you will do for each of those, and by when?
Tomorrow, I'll call Mrs. Njeri to get that order signed for Greenfield. For Tuskys Westgate, I need to arrange to show Peter the samples first.
Understood. For each of those, what stage is it at now: Contacted, Need established, Pitched, Qualified, Quoted, or Won?
Greenfield Supermarket is 'Won'. Tuskys Westgate is at 'Contacted'.
You have Greenfield Supermarket as 'Won' and Tuskys Westgate as 'Contacted'. When you say Greenfield is 'Won', what exists that shows it?
Mrs. Njeri said yes on the phone. That's how I know it's won.

You have a verbal confirmation from Mrs Njeri for Greenfield. For instance, anything written down that captures this - an email, perhaps a purchase order, or anything similar. If you have it, attach it using the button at the bottom - I want to know what it shows.

I have one more question before we finish. What do you need from other people?

I don't have anything written down yet, but I'll be getting the signed order tomorrow. As for what I need from others, I need Joseph to bring me the sample units he promised so I can show them to Peter at Tuskys Westgate.
You need Joseph to bring the sample units for Tuskys Westgate. Is that still a conversation you want to have with Joseph?
Yes, it is. I need those samples to move forward with the Tuskys Westgate lead.
Understood. For each deal you are working on, how many units are you aiming to sell, and what is the amount?
This is about setting goals and keeping track of how the work is going. What are you trying to achieve this period?
I'm trying to sell 120 water dispensers by October 30th.

You are aiming for 40 units sold by October 30. That is the overall team target. You said 120 water dispensers, which is the team's number, not yours. What is your plan to reach the 40 units by October 30 that Grace set for you?
I'll focus on closing existing leads and following up on new ones.
That makes sense as a general approach. Can you tell me a bit more about what you're responsible for in your job?
I sell water dispensers to hotels, supermarkets, and shops in Nairobi.
To get a clearer picture of your plan, what specific next actions do you have for these existing leads and new ones, and by when?
I need to follow up with Wanjiru at Mama Pima Stores. I'll also drop samples off for Mercy on Thursday. For Juja Hardware, I need to speak to the owner.
That is exactly the kind of detail that makes a plan real. For Juja Hardware, what makes speaking to the owner the most important next step right now?
The shop assistant couldn't make any decisions.
Understood. Which of those sales will be with someone who can actually decide?
Mama Pima Stores and Juja Hardware.
That is what you have said so far. However, Grace also mentioned Kilele Hotel and Greenfield Supermarket. Do either of those factor into your plan?
I do not know. They have not come up for me.
It is worth getting your version of how what people said stand. What is your next step to find out more about Kilele Hotel and Greenfield Supermarket?
I will check my notes for any information on them. If not there, I will ask Grace.

check your notes is a good first step.

What else should I know?
Wanjiru from Mama Pima Stores wants 12,000 KES off for 10 units.
Understood. What is still not clear to you?
I do not know if Wanjiru is considering other suppliers.

I will ask her directly.
It helps to get a definition of what clear success looks like. What would tell you and me that you have achieved the 40 units?
When the 40 units are sold and the payments are confirmed.

I don't have an expected delivery date for Kilele Hotel yet. I'll arrange that with them.

Paul from Upper Hill Offices has not answered my call yet.

That is a situation where your contribution has not been seen. What specifically exists from that work that we could point to?
Last time you said "Tomorrow, I'll call Mrs. Njeri to get that order signed for Greenfield." What happened with that, and what else has moved since we last spoke?

Yes, I called Mrs. Njeri today and Greenfield signed the order! That's 25 units, KES 120,000, in the bag. I've got the photo of the signed order too.
